QuestInfo.name: [Sweet Like Honey] Get That Honey!
QuestInfo.0: Cassandra has a special gift for you to celebrate the season... What can it be?
QuestInfo.1: Cassandra has a special gift for you to celebrate the season... What can it be?
QuestInfo.2:
You've received the #t4320003#! Work on growing your Honey Butterfly!

#bHow to get a Pot of Honey: Hunt monsters around your level.
How to get your gift: Use 100 Pot of Honey items. You can get a gift once a day.
Event End Date: 10/14/2014 at 23:59:59#k

0.msg: #h0#, have you ever seen a #bHoney Butterfly#k?

1.msg: Honey Butterfly? Sounds like something you get at breakfast.

2.msg: Hey! #bThey're an adorable species that's a mix of honeybees and butterflies#k! You should be more open-minded. Apologize at once!

3.msg: Sorry, sorry. So... why are we talking about this?

4.msg: Oh, right. #h0#, do you want to try raising one of these sweet butterflies? They're very gentle, and eventually you can ride them.\r\n#bI'll even show you how to customize their appearance. It'll be your one-of-a-kind mount!#k\r\nSo, do you want one?

no.0: Well, that's fine. There are plenty of people out there who will raise this precious Honey Butterfly. Though this one seems to be getting awfully attached to you... I mean, just look at those eyes...

default.0: Wait, something went wrong. Talk to me again.
